status.detail: The narrow candidate passed twenty actual-script real-Git cases; the baseline passed eighteen controls and reproduced two expected identity gaps. The broader multi-commit membership proposal was adjudicated as an unsupported review experiment, not an author requirement. A history-preserving scoped fork cleanup now matches the proven candidate script, restores the pinned upstream documentation and tests, and preserves unrelated base drift. Its experiment thread is resolved. A recent existing Copilot request was reconciled from request history; five reviews have submitted and the sixth request is pending without a current-head result. No duplicate request was made. Literal public-suggestion gates and full review convergence remain incomplete.
